verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the story indirectly. Self-hosting lets you run the same open-source backend on your own servers or Postgres/SQLite, which gives custody of where data lives and how long it persists. The pricing page lists daily backups, a retention-related feature. Nothing documents explicit retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented deletion APIs or document-delete semantics, configurable retention/TTL policies, backup/log retention settings, account/deployment data-deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.
